properties.name: reflow2 stamps the server time on each node's creation and content change, and a caller cannot set it
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-28 ("reflow2 stamps writes"), gap 3 of the design-a-phenomenon skill
properties.statement: From the release that ships it, reflow2 records, from its own clock, when each node was created and when its content last changed (and keeps that time with each preserved prior wording). A caller cannot supply or change these stamps: a write that tries is refused. A node written before stamping began reads "not recorded"; a stamp that arrives by import or design copy reads "imported, not recorded here" unless the export's hash chain vouches for it. Readers that need an order (first: a prediction against the result that tests it) read these stamps, never caller-typed dates.
